Docs.summary: Specifies a base-64 encoded string of custom data. The base-64 encoded string is decoded to a binary array that is saved as a file on the Virtual Machine. The maximum length of the binary array is 65535 bytes. Note: Do not pass any secrets or passwords in customData property. This property cannot be updated after the VM is created. The property customData is passed to the VM to be saved as a file, for more information see [Custom Data on Azure VMs](https://azure.microsoft.com/blog/custom-data-and-cloud-init-on-windows-azure/). If using cloud-init for your Linux VM, see [Using cloud-init to customize a Linux VM during creation](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/virtual-machines/linux/using-cloud-init).
